needs.premise: Two canonical operations and two physical domains, same processor-one owner and split-owner profiles; split body/link/root/commit/release fragments and at most two epochs; external stop certificates, complete input-root relocation and gate atomicity are premises; no C execution or fairness/liveness proof

21 conditional declarations: one-transaction publication Step/Trace preservation, paired membership under freeze, unknown-stop guard, closing admission and credit/debt conservation; not full two-operation QNT or C memory refinement

Pre-backed entry root slots admit explicit procedure or frozen actual RC closure data/code lease before any capacity check, native allocation or possible GC; root enrollment shares epoch membership admission, rejected enrollment preserves upstream rooted custody; private raw storage contains no untracked SCMOBJ; reload collector-updated input slot only after publication permit; foreign-thread and mutable closure origin require qualified binding

One canonical operation holds VM-epoch publisher lease plus exclusive physical-domain link authority; bounded nonallocating fragments fill body, write next/head, install reserved root, commit result and live credit, then withdraw lease; raw refcount0, header/length/mark valid before link; all GC/header/root/diagnostic observers honor the lease/commit boundary; never hold capacity lock across grant or permit while requesting GC

Close new root/publisher enrollment first, retain precise active operation set, drain known publisher/root writers without holding a lock they need, freeze matching root and physical-list membership, retain frozen input-root cells through failed native result/rollback until view drain, setup every domain then mark; same-domain link serialization prevents lost head updates, split domains can publish concurrently; resize/teardown cannot remove an active domain or invalidate permit identity

Known private pre-permit failure uses matched allocator disposition; unknown malloc/free keeps canonical input root and capacity debt without replay; after any visible list/root fragment the service retains permit and rolls forward only after original writer stop and valid complete journal/layout, never guessed unlink/free; unknown writer stop or partial structure blocks freeze, not converted into isolated native debt; response loss alone queries committed result

Reserve exact operation/native/root/control credits before permit; transfer reserved to live once at canonical commit and to returned only on known no-allocation/free, quarantine unknown outcome; reconcile per-domain counters and native-only pending storage across sweep/resize without double-counting legacy requested_words_still or refunded temporary estimate; physical mmap/free backend and actual allocation receipt remain profile-specific

Replace make_sfun_stack_marker caller-fill/count1 path only for controlled cohort; SFUN/___run/kernel/GSTATE consumers accept no result before canonical commit and root-backed delivery; processor-one root/list domains remain stable across callback exit, resize and cleanup; metadata query cannot return into dead C activation or free marker; preserve original owner/thread and continuation guard contracts, legacy paths and raw APIs separately admitted

Actual C synchronization must refine membership/grant linearization, per-domain link exclusion, fragment writes before release permit, freeze acquire/revalidation and all-setup-before-mark; input root relocation/write permission and metadata reclamation cannot race ordinary field reads; unknown stop cannot be inferred from missing ACK or a scalar count; lock order excludes GC/allocator/owner cycles

Dedicated subtype candidate 16 with exact body size 2*wordBytes+24, two SCMOBJ cells then immutable raw key bytes; ordinary vector and FOREIGN are excluded representations; explicit scan case marks only cells zero and one; generated C and Scheme subtype tables, predicates, diagnostic walkers, size checks and module admission agree; candidate is not installed or globally ABI-certified

Immutable key is VM incarnation, activation slot and slot generation, each a bounded nonzero 64-bit component; all three decoded bytewise before protected registry lookup; no pointer identity, no wrap/reuse while any delayed observer can exist, exhaustion rejects; registry miss after managed classification is Closed, never legacy fallback; live original owner/thread and transport identity remain separate

Root explicit proc argument or frozen RC closure data before any allocation; pre-reserve root/control storage; private fully initialized still body starts raw refcount zero and mark -1; one no-safepoint/non-escaping publication gate commits still membership plus root enumeration before exposing marker; failure before commit retains inputs/private duty, unknown commit queries canonical service with backed roots; no unsafe public alloc_scmobj shortcut

Freeze all root-domain membership before all still-list setup, then global setup completion before root trace CAS, then typed body scan before strong/weak/sweep closure; enumerate every processor and constructor/quarantine root, including published but unclaimed views; still refcount zero does not eliminate explicit roots; root slot relocations are written back; no setup reset after any cross-processor mark

Captured frame keeps closed marker/key independently of activation metadata; permitted procedure clear never changes key or routing cell; release service root after view/object-borrow drain, but GC alone frees unreachable marker; no direct free at record retirement; drain/transfer VM root domain before unconditional cleanup still/RC; invalid raw pointer is never classified by dereference

C release/acquire or common lock covers input/root freeze, body/header/list/root commit and setup-before-mark; immutable fields still require lifetime-safe object borrow; registry lookup protects metadata before use; root slots cannot race relocation/clear; no atomics on a counter substitute for descriptor completeness or original-thread nonlocal jump legality

nodes.labelText: Pre-backed input root + canonical operation\nexplicit proc / frozen closure origin
Reserve capacity -> native allocation\nraw private storage; no SCMOBJ edge
Running epoch + domain authority\ngrant one publisher lease
Reload current rooted proc\nvalid header / body / count0
Write next + physical still head\nlease retains responsibility
Install reserved root entry\nnot independently snapshot-visible
Canonical result + live credit commit\nrelease lease; root-backed delivery
Close new enrollment / grants\ndrain exact active leases
Paired root / list / credit snapshot\nall domains setup before marking
Known stop + exact journal\nlinked path rolls forward
Unknown native allocation/free\nretain input root + quarantine credit
Existing still CAS + typed scan\nstrong / weak / sweep / reconcile
SysML -> ASCENT -> QNT / Lean\nsource and memory-order gaps open

callers.actualChain: make_sfun_stack_marker allocates vector before explicit proc or global closure data copy; TODO names proc relocation hazard
callers.hazard: A raw native local or reread global closure identity is not a frozen input root
callers.replacement: Pre-backed entry root and actual closure/code borrow before every allocating operation; rejected enrollment retains upstream custody

callers.actualChain: alloc_scmobj_still links then sets initial count1; make_vector fills body afterwards
callers.hazard: Caller-fill contract relies on current cooperative safe points; zero-count/independent worker cannot observe intermediate state
callers.replacement: Dedicated typed private preparation and lease-covered body/list/root/commit; generic controlled-subtype allocation refused

callers.actualChain: Aligned wrapper allocates native storage with backpointer; fast still path allocates then adds deferred words
callers.hazard: Native allocation is not root/list publication; storing movable proc too early can leave stale private payload
callers.replacement: Raw no-managed-edge shell plus persistent input root; native call outside publication permit

callers.actualChain: ALLOC_MEM_LOCK protects occupied/deferred accounting; released before ___garbage_collect/on_all_processors
callers.hazard: Allocation lock is not a still-list/root lock; holding future permit through GC self-blocks freeze
callers.replacement: Reserve before lease; separate capacity lock from epoch/domain authority; drop all publication permits before capacity-triggered GC

callers.actualChain: After slow allocation failure old code subtracts words; free wrapper hides free/munmap result
callers.hazard: Null, unknown allocation and unknown release are different; free_mem_code ignores munmap result
callers.replacement: Canonical reserved/live/returned/quarantine dispositions; no refund or second free from unknown reply

callers.actualChain: still_objs, scan queue, deferred words and RC head are PSTATE fields, independently initialized
callers.hazard: P0-only shared registry does not include processor-one lists/roots; processor id reuse invalidates raw ownership
callers.replacement: Stable physical-domain identity and grant generation, enumerate every domain; resize pins mapping while permits exist

callers.actualChain: register_rc links per-PSTATE RC header; mark_rc walks its data, invoked only in processor0 strong branch
callers.hazard: Adding another RC cell on processor1 is not a proven root adapter
callers.replacement: VM root domain includes construction/procedure slots directly; require qualified RC closure data transfer

callers.actualChain: GC sync op combines requested words, raises VM sync interrupt and rendezvous executes GC per processor
callers.hazard: Current SMP uses cooperative participation, not arbitrary concurrent still mutations; combined request is not physical credit ownership
callers.replacement: Keep original sync behavior for legacy; managed frozen-root/native participation and independent worker contract require source refactoring

callers.actualChain: Setup resets zero-count marks and folds deferred words; barrier precedes strong mark
callers.hazard: Freeze between root/list fragments or setup after cross-domain CAS loses root/work/accounting
callers.replacement: Close admission, drain leases, snapshot paired membership and counters, all-domain setup completion before any mark

callers.actualChain: mark_array still CAS links object to scanner work; body scanner needs managed subtype case
callers.hazard: Raw count0 does not itself root object; failed/unknown task claim cannot drop scan obligation
callers.replacement: Frozen canonical root feeds existing CAS with explicit scanner task responsibility and updateable cells

callers.actualChain: Sweep rebuilds list and words_still; determine_occupied_words sums all PSTATE live words; resize temporarily assumes requested words live
callers.hazard: Pending raw native storage is absent from swept list; repeated requested budget can charge twice or be erased by recount
callers.replacement: Separate pending native credit ledger from published live words; generation-stable reconciliation at sweep/resize

callers.actualChain: Generated static/dynamic SFUN and GSTATE create/kill function pointers consume marker contract
callers.hazard: Old object ABI and caller-fill/count1 assumptions cannot consume new result slot blindly
callers.replacement: Scheme emits typed entry/root/activation descriptors; C service returns root-backed canonical result with module capability admission

callers.actualChain: ___run creates/calls/kills marker; ___call matches rooted marker; source and generated kernel read vector fields
callers.hazard: Response receipt is not live native return authority; forgotten generated C consumers bypass checks
callers.replacement: Preserve original activation/thread/guard, no result exposure before committed custody; regenerate or reject old consumers

callers.actualChain: Child ___run exit sends error to P0 then services sync ops; teardown frees still/RC and VM cleanup names P0 with other-processors TODO
callers.hazard: Logical processor exit is not native writer stop; extra root/permit does not survive unconditional teardown
callers.replacement: Drain or transfer all per-domain operations/root/native credits before domain and lock destruction; unknown stop refuses removal

callers.actualChain: Tcl command, server error callback and function-valued callback instantiate real native entries
callers.hazard: Nested callback/error/delete can leave construction result or native resource in flight
callers.replacement: Reuse canonical entry/activation/root service with explicit exception custody; no hidden Tcl semantics rewrite

callers.actualChain: SUPPORT_LOWLEVEL_EXEC routes heap alloc/free to code allocator; mmap path adds two size words, release discards munmap status
callers.hazard: 103/67 aligned-wrapper bytes are not universally OS allocation/RSS or proven successful release
callers.replacement: Profile records malloc versus mmap backend and known/unknown disposition; page/usable/RSS costs remain unresolved
